statement: The canonical A0 complete-state codec round-trips every supported width and every outcome or trap form, and rejects the declared malformed encodings.
scope: Forty-eight complete states: eight supported widths crossed with running, halted, and all four trap forms; ten malformed encodings covering format identity, widths, reserved bits, tags, trap consistency, truncation, and trailing bytes.
exclusions: Exhaustive enumeration of every complete A0 state
A Python projection of the Rust codec

negative_control.mutates: Accept one trailing byte after an otherwise canonical complete-state encoding

limitations: The route covers every width and outcome form but only a named finite state population.
The checker and codec share one Axeyum repository; the report is implementation-bound computation evidence, not a certificate.
